baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural imperative انطلقوا governs movement إلى a singular ظل whose internal specification is ثلاث شعب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Unrestrained departure converges on one covering form, but that form immediately diverges into exactly three branches. The focus therefore combines directed motion with a terminal spatial split.

activation_trace.role: Unrestrained setting-out supplies the command's forward kinetic force.
Shade as covering supplies the singular destination-form toward which movement converges.
The exact number three fixes the destination's division rather than leaving it vaguely multiple.
Separating and branching turns the destination into a three-way terminal divergence.

changed_reading.before: A command simply tells a group to go to a shade with three branches.
changed_reading.after: The command sends a plurality through one approach into a precisely three-way spatial funnel.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظل can name protective shelter, while ثلاث and شعب can describe an ordered structure assembled from divided parts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus alone permits the destination to present as an engineered refuge: a protective overhead form composed of three joined or supporting divisions. Because movement is commanded, however, its welcome appearance remains only apparent, not yet verified.

activation_trace.role: Release from restraint gives the movement an initially permissive or relieving surface.
Protective shelter and patronage supply the apparent refuge-function.
A thing made of three parts supplies an assembled structural image.
Joining and mending a split allows the three divisions to function as one sheltering construction.

changed_reading.before: The shade is only a natural shadow divided three ways.
changed_reading.after: The wording can initially stage an apparently ordered, three-part refuge whose actual protective value is still unknown.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction انطلقوا إلى favors traversal, and شعب can denote a pass or opening between heights as well as branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: An overhead canopy combined with a mountain-cleft or branching-pass image converts the shade from a static patch into route geometry: a covered approach that divides into three passages.

activation_trace.role: Unheld forward movement makes the destination something traversed rather than merely viewed.
An overhead canopy supplies the covered vertical boundary of the route.
A three-part construction fixes the route network's threefold geometry.
The mountain cleft or branching pass supplies a traversable corridor rather than a botanical limb.

changed_reading.before: The destination is a static object casting shade.
changed_reading.after: The destination can be read as a covered three-way pass through which the commanded group must move.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening chain sends, drives, spreads, separates, and casts. The focus replays that sequence on the addressees: they are released into motion and delivered to a branching separation, making them the processed material of the earlier kinetic pattern.

activation_trace.role: Release from restraint anchors the replay in the focus imperative.
Branching separation anchors the replay's terminal dispersal in the focus destination.
Sending and being set in motion supplies the opening stage of the process template.
Rapid impulsion supplies acceleration after release.
Opening, spreading, and ramifying supplies expansion into multiple directions.
Scattering into parts supplies the separation stage echoed by three branches.
Casting something onward supplies delivery to a terminal location.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 forms an ordered participial chain of sending, driving, spreading, separating, and casting.
The focus begins with another release-motion expression and ends with a branching destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an ordered opening sequence and the focus's release-plus-branching image. Reader arrow: the opening sequence functions as a process template later applied to the addressees. Live alternative: the opening chain may orient the surah without being mechanically replayed in 77:30.

changed_reading.before: The command is an isolated movement toward an ominous object.
changed_reading.after: The command makes the addressees undergo the surah's opening kinetics: release, acceleration, spread, separation, and delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same day is characterized by gathering previously separated populations and by establishing decisive boundaries. Against that gather-then-separate mechanism, the exactly three شعب become routing channels: one collected plurality is redistributed through a triadic classifier.

activation_trace.role: The number three fixes the count of routing outcomes.
Branching apart supplies the distributive movement after gathering.
A people-group gathering tribes allows the branches also to carry a social-grouping image.
Making a boundary visible between things supplies the classifier's separating operation.
Joining the dispersed into one gathered body supplies the input population to be routed.

structural_cues: The Day of Separation is named at 77:13-14 and again at 77:38.
77:38 places separation and the gathering of the present and earlier peoples in one utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: repeated separation language, an explicit gathering, and an exactly three-branched focus destination. Reader arrow: gathering precedes redistribution through the branches. Live alternative: the branches may remain wholly physical while gathering and separation describe judgment without spatial routing.

changed_reading.before: The three branches are only physical divisions in a shade-form.
changed_reading.after: The three branches can also function as a sorting architecture that receives a gathered multitude and routes it across fixed divisions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding earth-system gathers bodies, anchors elevations, and supplies sweet water. The focus then offers the outline of a habitat, a cover approached by its occupants, but its branching form is followed by denial of cover and exposure to flame. The destination is thus a material anti-habitat: enclosure-form with its sustaining functions reversed.

activation_trace.role: Protective shelter supplies the habitat-function evoked by the focus noun.
Internal branching replaces a unified holding environment with dispersive structure.
Gathering and holding in a container supplies the earth-system's enclosing function.
Firm rootedness supplies environmental stability.
Giving drink supplies the habitat's sustaining flow.
Sweet fresh water specifies the beneficial quality of that sustaining flow.
Ordinary covering is invoked precisely as the function negated from the focus shade.
The tongue and ignition of fire replace the preceding water ecology with destructive heat.

structural_cues: 77:25-27 presents earth as a gathering place with anchored heights and fresh water.
After the refrain at 77:28, 77:29-31 moves directly to the commanded destination and strips its shade of efficacy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a functioning earth-water environment followed by a shade that does not shade against flame. Reader arrow: the adjacent systems are material inversions, so the focus structure is an anti-habitat. Live alternative: the two passages may be separate demonstrations with no designed ecological reversal.

changed_reading.before: The focus names one locally ineffective shelter.
changed_reading.after: The focus builds the outline of a whole anti-habitat: gathering without safety, structure without stability, and cover exposed to fire instead of supplied by water.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding command directs the addressees toward what they had classified as false; the focus repeats the command and specifies a concrete destination. Epistemic rejection is therefore reversed into unavoidable spatial encounter.

activation_trace.role: Unrestrained going anchors the repeated imperative's compelled forward motion.
The covering-form supplies the concrete object encountered after denial.
Attributing something to falsehood supplies the rejected status now overturned by encounter.
The immediately preceding identical motion imperative makes 77:30 a specification of the same commanded movement.

structural_cues: 77:29 immediately precedes the focus and ends by naming what the addressees had treated as false.
The same plural imperative opens both 77:29 and 77:30, while the second supplies the more specific إلى destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an immediately repeated imperative, first toward what was denied and then toward the three-branched shade. Reader arrow: the second destination concretizes the first and turns denial into encounter. Live alternative: the repetition may only continue the command without making spatial encounter an epistemic reversal.

changed_reading.before: The imperative merely starts movement toward a strange shade.
changed_reading.after: The repeated imperative makes the shade the concrete arrival of what had been denied, converting rejected claim into compelled experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the shade root only to deny shade-density and any sufficiency against flame. The focus destination preserves the visible category of shelter while losing the causal work that makes shelter shelter.

activation_trace.role: Protective shelter supplies the expected function whose failure matters.
Projecting forked parts preserve a shelter-like silhouette even when protection fails.
Shade as covering names the ordinary function explicitly negated by لا ظليل.
Sufficiency names the protective adequacy explicitly denied.
The flame's burning tongue supplies the hazard the apparent shelter cannot block.

structural_cues: 77:31 is the immediate syntactic continuation of the destination description.
Its paired negations remove both shade-quality and practical protection from flame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a thing called shade followed by explicit denial of shade and protective sufficiency. Reader arrow: the mismatch is functional counterfeit, not merely weak shade. Live alternative: the wording may describe an abnormal physical shade without foregrounding counterfeit refuge as a mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The three-part structure is an actual, though ominous, refuge.
changed_reading.after: It is a shelter-sign emptied of shelter-function: an overhead silhouette that attracts or receives movement but cannot cover or save.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flame is followed by active throwing and airborne sparks. This dynamic sequence reorients the three forked parts from architectural supports to emission channels or plume-trajectories spreading above the addressees.

activation_trace.role: An overhead canopy supplies the broad upper field occupied by the emissions.
A three-part form fixes the number of channels or lobes.
Forked projecting parts supply the geometry of diverging trajectories.
Ignited flame supplies the energetic source of the field.
Sending or throwing supplies outward trajectory rather than static support.
Flying fire-sparks supply the emitted material moving through those trajectories.

structural_cues: 77:30-32 proceeds without a refrain from branched shade, to failed protection from flame, to active spark-throwing.
The subject in 77:32 is represented as an active emitter rather than a passive backdrop.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an overhead three-fork form followed by flame, throwing, and airborne sparks. Reader arrow: the branches map the emitter's diverging channels or plume-lobes. Live alternative: the shade may be a static structure adjacent to, rather than produced by, the spark-throwing source.

changed_reading.before: The branches are fixed limbs of a shelter-like object.
changed_reading.after: The branches can be read dynamically as three diverging emission paths forming an overhead field of flame-driven ejecta.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later shade is paired with people characterized by self-protection and with flowing springs. That complete shelter-water ecology supplies a positive counterpart against which the focus shade appears not merely defective but deliberately stripped of refuge and provision.

activation_trace.role: Protective shelter supplies the function contested across the two shade scenes.
Branching division marks the focus shade as internally dispersive rather than a unified refuge.
Actual covering shade supplies the same-root positive counterpart.
Ward-off protection makes safety an explicit relational feature of the later shade scene.
A flowing water-source supplies provision alongside genuine cover.

structural_cues: 77:41 repeats the shade root in the plural and coordinates it with springs.
The later scene follows the same-surah punishment scene and assigns its shade to a contrasting group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two same-surah shade scenes, one denied efficacy and one paired with protection and springs. Reader arrow: the later scene is a designed functional counterpart that exposes the focus shade as refuge-form without refuge-relation. Live alternative: the scenes may simply describe different outcomes without making the shared root carry a deliberate counterfeit contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus shade is independently defective.
changed_reading.after: It is the negative counterpart of a complete shade ecology: the form of refuge allocated without the protection, water, or relational safety that make refuge real.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a later refused bodily posture to earlier landscape geometry. It remains anchored in commanded movement, an overhead canopy, شعب as a pass, and ركع as lowering the head; downstream prose should present it only as a possible spatial echo, never as a claim that shade or branches lexically mean bowing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: انطلقوا requires traversal, ظل can be overhead, and شعب can be a mountain pass through which a body moves.

activation_trace.role: Unrestrained going supplies bodily traversal of the focus route.
An overhead canopy supplies a vertical constraint above the traveler.
A mountain cleft or pass supplies the constrained route geometry.
Spoken command supplies the later imperative that was refused.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the posture potentially echoed by passage beneath the canopy.

changed_reading.before: The addressees merely enter a three-way covered pass.
changed_reading.after: Their unavoidable passage beneath an overhead three-way structure may spatially echo the lowering they later are said to have refused.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the specialized third-hearthstone image and transfers an eating branch to fire. It remains anchored in the explicit three, forked parts, canopy, and nearby flame; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy of reversed shelter, not identify the three branches literally as hearthstones.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ثلاث can evoke a three-support object, شعب supplies forked projecting parts, and ظل supplies an overhead form whose function can be inverted.

activation_trace.role: The overhead canopy supplies the shelter-form reversed into a heating or consuming structure.
The third hearthstone supplies a specialized three-support material analogy.
Forked projecting parts supply support-like limbs around the heated center.
Ignited flame supplies the hearth's destructive heat.
Feeding fire and its ignition reverses the eating command into an image of the fire as consumer.

changed_reading.before: The three branches form failed shelter above the addressees.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the triadic form can invert canopy into a three-support hearth, placing the addressees inside a consuming rather than sheltering apparatus.

strongest_changes: The repeated imperative in 77:29-30 converts prior denial into compelled spatial encounter with the focus destination.
77:31 removes both covering and sufficiency from the thing called shade, while 77:41 supplies a genuine shade-water counterpart.
The gather/separate language makes the exactly three branches available as a routing or sorting structure, not only a physical silhouette.
The opening send-spread-separate-cast chain can be replayed on the addressees as they are released toward branching division.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package changed the focus from a single bizarre landscape object into several coexisting mechanisms: compelled encounter, counterfeit refuge, anti-habitat, sorting funnel, and dynamic emission field. Distant same-surah repetitions sharpened function without forcing those models into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus grammar does not decide whether the branches are static divisions, traversable passes, or dynamic emission paths.
The gather-then-sort and anti-habitat mechanisms depend on reader-supplied directional links across separated passages, even though their packet elements are explicit.
The lowering-pass and hearth analogies rely on cross-domain branch transfer and should remain explicitly exploratory.
